title: Yoga Classes In Bali at Bali Yoga School
intro: Located in Ubud, the heart of Bali, the training centre has a calm vibe that helps you connect with your inner self better.

Daily drop-in yoga classes are conducted separately, they are not part of any yoga program in our ashram. We customise classes according to beginners, intermediate and advanced practitioners. Each yoga class fee is 15 USD, to book a class kindly contact us.
